title: Bow My Knees Before The Father

request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft percussion, hopeful and reverent mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I stand in the light of your grace
With boldness I find in your face
No fear in my heart any more
I come to you with quiet prayer

[Chorus]
I bow my knees before the Father
From whom every family is named
In heaven above and on earth below
Your name is the one that remains

[Verse]
Not faint from the weight of the cost
For this is the glory I lost
And found in the strength of your hand
Where you love and where you stand

[Chorus]
I bow my knees before the Father
From whom every family is named
In heaven above and on earth below
Your name is the one that remains

[Bridge]
Riches of glory pour out
Strength in the spirit and doubt
You grant me the power to be
Rooted and grounded in thee

[Chorus]
I bow my knees before the Father
From whom every family is named
In heaven above and on earth below
Your name is the one that remains

[Outro]
Bow my knees before the Father
Your name is the one that remains
